name: Through the Window
source:
School is boring...

The days are tiring...

Until the popular girl at school suddenly starts talking to you and you start having dreams of the social outcast...

Can you win your way into Vanessa's heart? Can you help a lost girl find her way?

Pick the right options and uncover the deeper truth hiding underneath...

Can you see through the window?
